queries:
SELECT p.oid::bigint,p.proowner::bigint,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,
    pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_function_result(p.oid),l.lanname,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(p::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')
    FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE p.oid='ingest.validate_generation(bigint)'::regprocedure
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND k.contype='f'
SELECT version,content_sha256,applied_at::text,code_commit FROM ingest.schema_migrations ORDER BY version
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT kind,key,definition FROM (
 SELECT 'table' kind,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname key,ROW(c.relkind,c.relrowsecurity,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl::text,c.reloptions)::text definition
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attnum,ROW(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),a.attacl::text)::text
 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||k.conname,ROW(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid),k.convalidated,k.condeferrable,k.condeferred)::text FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'index',schemaname||'.'||indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||t.tgname,ROW(t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))::text FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')',ROW(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['oid','pronamespace','proowner','prolang','proargtypes','proallargtypes','prorettype'],l.lanname,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_function_result(p.oid),obj_description(p.oid,'pg_proc'))::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'sequence',s.schemaname||'.'||s.sequencename,ROW(s.start_value,s.min_value,s.max_value,s.increment_by,s.cycle,s.cache_size,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl::text)::text FROM pg_sequences s JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=s.schemaname JOIN pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=s.sequencename WHERE s.schemaname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'schema',n.nspname,ROW(pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),n.nspacl::text)::text FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'view',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,ROW(c.relkind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl::text,c.reloptions,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid),ARRAY(SELECT ROW(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attgenerated,CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END)::text FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum))::text FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relkind IN ('v','m')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'role',r.rolname,ROW(r.rolsuper,r.rolinherit,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolreplication,r.rolconnlimit,r.rolvaliduntil,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolconfig)::text FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('orion_pro_owner','orion_pro_ingest','orion_pro_runtime')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',r.rolname||'->'||m.rolname,ROW(g.rolname,a.admin_option,a.inherit_option,a.set_option)::text FROM pg_auth_members a JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=a.roleid JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid=a.member JOIN pg_roles g ON g.oid=a.grantor WHERE r.rolname IN ('orion_pro_owner','orion_pro_ingest','orion_pro_runtime') OR m.rolname IN ('orion_pro_owner','orion_pro_ingest','orion_pro_runtime')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default_acl',r.rolname||'.'||coalesce(n.nspname,'GLOBAL')||'.'||d.defaclobjtype::text,d.defaclacl::text FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=d.defaclrole LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE (d.defaclnamespace=0 OR n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) AND (r.rolname IN ('orion_pro_owner','orion_pro_ingest','orion_pro_runtime') OR d.defaclrole IN (SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')))
) catalogue ORDER BY kind,key
SELECT current_database(),pg_postmaster_start_time(),(SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid())

SELECT p.oid::text,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),(to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['prosrc','oid','pronamespace','proowner','prolang','proargtypes','proallargtypes','prorettype'])::text,l.lanname,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_function_result(p.oid),obj_description(p.oid,'pg_proc') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='ingest' AND p.proname='validate_generation' AND p.proargtypes='20'::oidvector
SELECT version,content_sha256,applied_at::text,code_commit FROM ingest.schema_migrations ORDER BY version
SELECT ROW(j.*)::text FROM ingest.schema_migrations j ORDER BY version
SELECT ROW(s.*)::text FROM ingest.dataset_snapshots s WHERE transform_version='bootstrap_v1'

SELECT r.id,r.status,r.transform_version,r.code_commit,r.checkpoint->>'phase',s.id,s.generation,s.status,s.manifest_sha256 FROM ingest.import_runs r JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots s ON s.id=(r.checkpoint->>'snapshot_id')::bigint ORDER BY s.generation

SELECT d.legacy_object_path,r.external_key,r.locator,s.source_record_id,s.revision_id,s.match_id,s.player_id,s.team_id,s.match_player_revision_id,s.source_id,s.period_code,s.period_definition_version,s.variant_key,s.recorded_from_gen,s.aerial_duels_attempted,s.aerial_duels_won,s.assists,s.big_chances_created,s.blocks,s.chances_created,s.clearances,s.defensive_actions,s.dribbles_completed,s.dribbles_attempted,s.duels_lost,s.duels_won,s.goals,s.goals_prevented,s.interceptions,s.minutes_played,s.non_penalty_xg,s.passes_completed,s.passes_attempted,s.passes_final_third,s.provider_rating,s.recoveries,s.saves,s.shots,s.shots_on_target,s.tackles,s.touches,s.touches_box,s.xa,s.xg,s.xgot,ma.public_key,pa.public_key,ta.public_key FROM football.player_match_stats s JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=s.source_record_id JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=r.document_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current ma ON ma.route_kind='match' AND ma.match_id=s.match_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current pa ON pa.route_kind='player' AND pa.player_id=s.player_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current ta ON ta.route_kind='team' AND ta.team_id=s.team_id WHERE s.is_canonical AND s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL ORDER BY s.source_record_id

SELECT source_record_id,metric_code,value_kind,numeric_value,text_value,boolean_value,numerator,denominator,source_display,match_id,player_id,team_id,match_player_revision_id,source_id,period_code,period_definition_version,variant_key,recorded_from_gen,metric_definition_version FROM football.player_match_metric_values WHERE is_canonical AND recorded_to_gen IS NULL ORDER BY source_record_id,metric_code
SELECT code,unit,scope,aggregation,allows_negative FROM football.metric_definitions ORDER BY code

SELECT raw_key,metric_code,metric_definition_version,mapping_version,parse_rule->>'common_column',parse_rule->>'common_sql_type',parse_rule->>'number_projection' FROM football.source_metric_mappings WHERE family_code='normalized_performance' ORDER BY raw_key
